title: Ascend
subtitle: An Android goal planner with an AI coach, x-rayed from its code: phone, widget, AI server and the models behind it.

flows.title: Claude drafts your plan via the Ascend AI server
flows.caption: Plan builder → AI layer → Worker checks device & quota in KV → Claude → draft saved on the phone

flows.title: Gemini reads your goals and asks up to three questions
flows.caption: Plan builder → AI layer checks the shared-key cap → Gemini straight from the phone → answers saved

flows.title: You accept the plan and it lands on your schedule
flows.caption: One Room transaction writes goals and tasks, then the widget refreshes and reminders are rescheduled

flows.title: You tick off a task from the home-screen widget
flows.caption: Widget → Repository picks ideal or minimum → completion saved → widget redraws

estimates.note: Hop latencies are estimates, not measurements. AI latencies come from the repo's own notes (GeminiClient.kt timings, 'under a minute' plan copy).

assumptions: Anthropic timeout is the phone's 90 s read timeout (AiService.kt:102); the Worker sets none of its own.
Anthropic counts as one attempt: the Worker's SDK may retry (default maxRetries 2), but the phone stops waiting after its single 90 s read timeout.
Gemini down = 3 attempts × 90 s: a read timeout becomes a 504 (AiClient.kt:256) and the loop moves to the next of 3 intake models (GeminiClient.kt:73, :119).
Traffic is illustrative: the Worker caps the whole server at 2000 requests/day (wrangler.toml).
